row.notes: Returns at once if dept byte +0x72 > 3 or the last entry fitted byte already equals the value. History vector +0xc0..+0xc8 (cap +0xd0, alloc +0xb8, 16-byte entries; empty -> sentinel {0xffff3fff0000, state 5}). If last entry day (+4) differs, pushes a copy; writes day +4, fitted byte +9, byte +0xb, owner key +0 (unless 0x3fff), and inst +0xae/+0xb0. (lane owner review requested)

verify.notes: V6073 dept>3 early return verified (cmp [rcx+0x72],3); flag byte +9 set from param_3; also stamps entry time (+4) and +0xb; pushes new state entry when value changes
V9232 cmp byte [rcx+0x72],3 / ja returns early; otherwise it writes the byte at entry+9 (fitted) of the last 0x10-byte state entry.
